response.overview: Deep in the ancient wilderness of the Finger Lakes, a choreographer sets out to create The Dance Poems of the Vestals, an ambitious ritualistic dance piece meant to cure the modern epidemic of isolation and lack of meaning. Tracking the performance from its fragile conception to its opening night, the film intertwines her creative crucible with the surrounding rural community, as both seek to reignite the sacred flame of human relationships and a forgotten connection to the natural world.
response.title: Temple of Vesta
